item.title: DISTRICT 2 BASKETBALL: Tournaments tip off Tuesday
item.description: Local high school basketball teams begin their quest for championships and possibly more when the District 2 tournaments tip off Tuesday with a 16-game slate of contests in Class 5A and Class 4A boys, and Class 2A, Class 3A and Class 6A girls. In girls Class 2A, top-seeded Wyoming Seminary opens at home against Lackawanna Trail on Tuesday at 7 p.m. to highlight the opening night of the tournament. item.title: COMMUNITY DIGEST: Feb. 17, 2026
item.description: Greater Hazleton Area and beyond Hazleton Art League’s Annual Member Show: Through Feb. 22. Hayden Family Center for the Arts, 31 W. Broad St., Hazleton. The Members’ Exhibition is one of the Art League’s most popular events of the year, showcasing the talent of local artists. Many of the featured works will be available for purchase, with a portion of each sale supporting the Hazleton Art League. For information, call 570-455-3333 or visit hazletonartleague.org.
